biotools.summary: AF3Complex is a modified version of AlphaFold 3 designed to improve the prediction of protein complex structures, particularly challenging types like protein-peptide and antibody-antigen complexes.  It demonstrates superior performance compared to AlphaFold 3 in benchmarking tests and has been deployed successfully in CASP16-like scenarios.
